set.body: Build the test proof surface for the shared paired latent family. Acceptance: PLSC cross-covariance equivalence, CCA perfect-correlation and asymmetric-ridge cases, RRR exact low-rank recovery and full-rank OLS equivalence, row/rank rejection tests, and original-scale RRR prediction after response inverse preprocessing all run in shared JVM and JS tests.
set.title: Multivar: add paired latent synthetic and metamorphic tests
